params.literal_rule_verdict: redundancy_supported — ic_ir 0.1824 exceeds the pre-registered 0.18 boundary
params.effect_size_caveat: It clears the boundary by 0.0006. The boundary was drawn at the reference layer's own value, so this margin is noise and must not be read as the distinct layer outperforming.
params.what_the_evidence_actually_shows: Removing the nine redundant equity names recovers the entire fall (0.1455 -> 0.1824). Adding the five distinct names to the reference eleven buys 0.0006. Redundancy explains the damage; distinctness-adjusted expansion is still not a lever.
params.premise_failure: The P1 pre-registration computed its noise-reduction premise from nominal counts, treating members as independent draws. Effective sample size is pinned near 3 across every layer tested and never rose above 3.02, so the predicted ~35% noise reduction was unavailable by construction.
params.conclusion: Universe size is not a lever for this factor on this asset class. IC IR tracks effective sample size monotonically and effective sample size does not respond to adding correlated ETFs.
params.monotonicity_note: Excluded from the decision in advance, as registered. Recorded only: 1.00 at both 11 and 16 names, 0.50 at 25.
